text: Heather is an absolutely incredible painter and person! My husband  and I recently got married and we were lucky enough to have Heather as one of our vendors. Prior to our special day, Heather spent over an hour with us on the phone to finalize the details of our painting and help make our vision come to life. She is attentive, patient, professional, and HIGHLY talented! Our guests could not get over how amazing Heather was and how beautiful her work is. This is a MUST HAVE for your wedding!

owner_reply.text: Thank you Hannah!! I say it to all my couples… taking our time during the consultation call helps us create the PERFECT layout!! I am so glad we spent the extra effort to get the painting layout perfect!! It turned out amazing!!
